note: Human art approvals are recorded here, in the repository, never in the player save. Only entries with status GRANTED unlock anything; anything else (REVOKED, or a missing status) keeps the artifacts in TEMP/proposal state.

approvals.note: Granted and then revoked the same day. The frames stay proposals: status PROPOSAL_V1, designLocked false, animationBlocked true. The record is kept so the history is auditable instead of silently deleted.
